title: 3 stage knife sharpener
text: 3 stage knife sharpener. I like sharp knives.  I sharpen them after every wash. So I need an easy to use sharpener - that can sit on the counter. This one is very easy to use.  Having said all of that, I never hesitate to update my reviews should new info seem useful.

product_metadata.title: Ceramic Knife Sharpener - Handheld Kitchen Chef's 3-Stage Sharpener for Metal & Ceramic Knives - With Ergonomic Handle, Non-Slip Rubber Base & Storage Pouch
features: ☑️ Keep Your Knives Sharp: The sharpening process has 3 stages, fine, coarse, and ceramic, for various shapes and materials of different knives; Use once a week and knives will always cut like new; not suitable for serrated knives or scissors

☑️ Use on Ceramic and Metal Knives: We aim to provide our customers with the best kitchen tools so we made sure that this sharpener works well on both ceramic and metal knives, to ensure that they are always ready for your experiments in the kitchen

☑️ Ergonomic Handle & Non-Slip Rubber Base for Easy Use: The knife sharpener features an ergonomic handle for a comfortable grip that eases any strain and a non-slip rubber base to keep the sharpener in place; Easy to use if you're left or right-handed

☑️ Ideal for the Home Chef: This knife sharpener is designed to help assist home chefs; It is made from high-quality plastic with metal and ceramic fillings, with a velvet touch to ensure comfort whilst sharpening, and works perfectly on Japanese knives
☑️ Easy to Store in Velvet Drawstring Pouch: The kitchen knife sharpener comes with its own velvet drawstring pouch to store your priority sharpening device and keep it clean and free from dust
description: Love spending time in the kitchen and looking for the right tools to help you out?  At The Cook Chef Co., we love people who feel at home in the kitchen, those who love to experiment with new recipes or play with the latest tools and gadgets while finding their inner chef. And because we love you, we want to help bring out the chef in you by providing you with the best quality kitchen tools that are easy to use. That brings us to the 3-stage chef knife sharpener, a high-quality plastic sharpener with metal and ceramic fillings that is great for both metal & ceramic knives. The 3 different sharpening stages (fine, coarse, & ceramic) allow for knives of different shapes and materials. The ergonomic handle and non-slip rubber base make this device comfortable and easy to use and great for all those who find themselves at home in the kitchen. The sharpening device comes with an included velvet drawstring pouch to store the sharpener and keep it clean and free from dust. The sharpener is not dishwasher safe and it is recommended that a banister brush be used to clean the ceramic and metal fillings. The device is not suitable for use with serrated blades or scissors. Keep out of reach of children.  What makes our sharpener the ideal tool for a chef's knife?  - Ergonomic handle - Non-slip rubber base - 3-stage sharpening process for different shapes and materials of customers knives (ceramic/metal)  Includes - Velvet drawstring pouch to store and keep safe  We love it when you spend time in the kitchen trying new recipes and putting healthy twists on favorite dishes, and we want to bring out the best chef in you by providing you with the best tools
